notes.front: Does damage lower a unit's Might?
notes.back: No. Damage never reduces Might — it is marked on the unit (use counters).

notes.front: Does a temporary '-X Might this turn' debuff defeat an already-damaged unit?
notes.back: Yes. Akali 3M took 4 damage, was saved by En Garde (+2M -> 5M) with 4 damage marked, then hit by Eclipse (-4 Might this turn) -> 1M.

notes.front: Does healing happen after a showdown even if combat damage was never calculated?
notes.back: Yes. Annie put 5 damage on a 6-Might Master Yi; the attacker moved in two units and the defender wiped both with Cannon Barrage before damage was calculated.

notes.front: Does Red Akali's in-and-out 'when I move' ping persist if she leaves the showdown?
notes.back: No. If she is the only unit, leaving ends the showdown and the damage heals — you cannot stack chip damage by bouncing alone.

notes.front: Does focus pass automatically when a chain resolves?
notes.back: Yes — and this is widely misplayed. Focus passes to the other player any time a chain resolves; you cannot resolve your own spell and immediately fire another.

notes.front: Can you play an action after passing once in a showdown?
notes.back: Yes. Attacker may act; if they decline or their action resolves, defender may; then back to attacker, repeating until BOTH pass consecutively, at which point combat damage is dealt.

notes.front: Are 'Add'-type energy abilities reactable?
notes.back: No. Exhausting something like Lux, Crownguard for energy behaves like tapping runes — it is not reactable and puts nothing on the chain.

notes.front: If a Might debuff expires and a unit crosses back above the threshold, does it 'become Mighty' again?
notes.back: Yes, and it re-triggers 'when I become Mighty' effects.

notes.front: Does Stun prevent a unit from gaining Might?
notes.back: No. Stun reads only 'it doesn't deal combat damage this turn' and has zero interaction with gaining or losing Might.

notes.front: Does Abandoned Hall's ability trigger if the spell is countered?
notes.back: No. Abandoned Hall's "when a player plays a spell" condition is fulfilled only when that spell finishes resolving.

notes.front: Can a unit moved into or away from Abandoned Hall by a spell be targeted?
notes.back: After the spell resolves, Abandoned Hall can choose only a unit at Abandoned Hall controlled by the player who played that spell.

notes.front: Can Abandoned Hall's triggered ability choose a unit that a spell plays there?
notes.back: Yes, if the player who played the spell controls that unit when the ability finalizes.

notes.front: If my Dazzling Aurora plays Akshan, Mischievous at the end of my turn, will the Dazzling Aurora I take from my opponent trigger that turn?
notes.back: No. You gain control of the enemy Dazzling Aurora after its end-of-turn trigger condition has already been checked.

notes.front: If my opponent and I each use Akshan, Mischievous to take the same gear, who controls it when either Akshan dies?
notes.back: The most recently played Akshan takes precedence while both are on the board.

notes.front: How are targets chosen when playing Alpha Strike?
notes.back: Alpha Strike's controller chooses its targets while finalizing the spell, in the following order.

notes.front: When and how is Alpha Strike's damage distributed?
notes.back: Alpha Strike's controller chooses how to distribute its damage during resolution, not while choosing targets.

notes.front: Alpha Strike — What if the friendly unit's might is reduced?
notes.back: If the friendly target remains legal but has lower might when Alpha Strike resolves, Alpha Strike uses that reduced might as the amount of damage to split.

notes.front: What if the chosen friendly unit leaves the board or becomes illegal before Alpha Strike resolves?
notes.back: Alpha Strike deals no damage if the chosen friendly unit is an illegal target when the spell resolves.

notes.front: What if a chosen enemy unit leaves a battlefield or becomes illegal before Alpha Strike resolves?
notes.back: An enemy unit takes no damage if it remains an illegal target when Alpha Strike resolves.

notes.front: How does Aphelios, Exalted interact with Svellsongur and Shady Spectacles?
notes.back: Aphelios triggers once when either Svellsongur or Shady Spectacles is attached to him, but another unit that becomes a copy of Aphelios through Shady Spectacles does not trigger.

notes.front: Does Applied Researchers reduce Repeat, Flow, and Deflect costs?
notes.back: Yes, provided Applied Researchers is Empowered and the cost belongs to a spell.

notes.front: Can Applied Researchers reduce Shock Blast's cost to zero?
notes.back: Yes, if Applied Researchers is Empowered, you can play Shock Blast for .

notes.front: Can I use Arcane Shift to banish the only unit I own and control at a battlefield I control, then play it there again?
notes.back: Yes, as long as the unit is not a token and you control that battlefield.
